description: This file is a shell script containing various test functions and test cases for Git pack-objects reuse and multi-pack index features. It automates testing different scenarios related to pack reuse, delta handling, and index writing, using Git commands and scripting logic.

methods.name: test_pack_reused
methods.description: Test if pack-objects are reused based on trace data.

methods.name: test_packs_reused
methods.description: Test if multiple packs are reused based on trace data.

methods.name: pack_position
methods.description: Get the position of an object within a pack index file.

methods.name: test_pack_objects_reused_all
methods.description: Test that all objects are reused from specified packs and perform index packing.

methods.name: test_pack_objects_reused
methods.description: Test that specified objects are reused, with focus on delta reuse.
